items.quote: "From the moment I started the call, I had this thought... 'He won’t be able to afford it.'"
items.statement: An agent assumed a prospect couldn't afford a product based on their situation without them saying so.

items.quote: Here’s my advice: Challenge your assumptions.
items.statement: Challenge your assumptions about a prospect's financial situation during sales interactions.
An agent had a self-limiting belief that the prospect's circumstances meant they couldn't buy.

items.quote: You’re no longer in a conversation. You’re in your own head.
items.statement: Assumptions can prevent a productive conversation from taking place in sales calls.

items.quote: let the conversation guide the outcome.
items.statement: Let the conversation guide the outcome instead of your preemptive judgments.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing assumptions that sabotage sales calls.
